summary.text: Dean Rummel is a Republican state senator from District 37 in Dickinson who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is retired from TMI Systems Design Corp. and previously served on the Dickinson Public School board.

paragraphs.text: Dean Rummel earned a bachelor's degree in business administration and accounting from Dickinson State University in 1980.
His career included accounting, sales and administrative positions with TMI Systems Design Corp., and his legislative biography lists him as retired.
He served on the Dickinson Public School board from 1999 to 2010 and chaired the North Dakota Education Fact Finding Commission.
Rummel has also served on the board of Badlands Crime Stoppers and with the Dickinson Rural Fire Department and Rescue Squad, and his legislative biography says he is married with three children.
He assumed office on December 1, 2022, succeeding Rich Wardner, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
His 2025 assignments include vice chair of the Finance and Taxation Committee and membership on the Transportation Committee.
